Introduction to author tools

On this page
  • Begin with the seller
  • Write the conversation and choose its performance
  • Decide how rewards are crafted
  • Build a fair challenge pool
  • Prepare, test and share

Author tools let you create the content behind Adorn Seller Framework (ASF): the seller’s conversation, item-payment challenges, recipe rules and prepared audio. They are for NPC authors, modlist creators and players building their own setup. Players using a finished seller pack can follow its instructions without preparing new dialogue themselves.

The tools work together. The seller gives the service a face, the conversation gives them a personality, the riddle defines the payment and the recipe defines what the player learns to craft. A prepared build connects the authored replies to native Skyrim dialogue.

Begin with the seller#

Read the ASF introduction to understand the player loop, then follow seller setup. Choose a reachable placed NPC, enable the service and decide whether to allow finished-outfit orders or keep the setup focused on recipes.

Author access is unlocked through the MCM. It exposes configuration controls; it does not supply a new NPC, install the item dependencies or make a progression pool balanced automatically.

Write the conversation and choose its performance#

The dialogue guide covers seven core exchanges and compatible alternative player prompts. Save separate drafts for the NPCs you author, with one active seller role at a time.

For each exchange, choose a stock recording, a selected personal take or silent preparation. The recording guide explains microphone capture, audio imports, waveform trimming and matching the recorded words to the reply.

Decide how rewards are crafted#

The recipe maker defines crafting materials per piece, parchment instructions and optional station locations. It supplies the rules used by new recipe orders; accepted orders retain their saved recipe.

This is separate from the riddle payment. A player can first solve the seller’s request to earn the note, then gather the recipe’s own materials to make each piece.

Build a fair challenge pool#

Start with the first-riddle guide. Select real answer items and quantities, then write a riddle that fairly points to them. The full riddle reference covers every field, the extra clue and the saved content format.

If you want reward progression, review tiers and fixed offers before enabling the optional tier rules. Starter content is an example pool, not a balanced progression ready for every modlist.

Writing assistance is optional. It offers suggestions for your chosen answers; you remain responsible for reviewing and saving the final wording.

Prepare, test and share#

Use Build and share a seller to turn saved drafts into matching dialogue records and audio. Changed native dialogue requires the build, game exit, installation and restart sequence.

Check the author requirements before building. Play through the seller’s conversation, hand-in, clues and rewards in Skyrim before distributing the setup, and confirm that their ordinary NPC dialogue is still available.
